Our Downham Way salon is for ladies and gents. Men can walk in: a dry cut is £18, and there are beard trims, a neck and sides tidy-up with a cut-throat finish, and traditional hot towel wet shaves.
For ladies there are cuts, blow dries, colour, perms and hair up. A cut and finish is £45 and full head highlights or lowlights are £90. Call the salon to book.
Senior citizens have a Tuesday price of £12 for a barber's cut, and we're open until 7pm on Fridays.

Paul's is an independent, family-run group of ladies and gents salons. The first opened in Bromley in 1978. 48 years on there are two: walk-in barbers on East Street, and a ladies and gents salon on Downham Way.
Two salons, one family, two different kinds of visit. Tap to call, or check who's open right now.
Clipper cuts, skin fades, beard trims and hot towel shaves. Walk in, no appointment needed.
Cuts, blow dries, colour, highlights, perms and hair up for special occasions, for ladies and gents. Men can walk in; ladies, call to book.
Clipper cuts, skin fades, beard trims and hot towel shaves at the barbers. Cuts, blow dries, colour, perms and hair up for ladies and gents on Downham Way. Senior and children’s prices at both.

Paul's started with one salon in Bromley in 1978. It's still independent and still family run, and it has sister businesses too: The Boutique Spa, and RP for Men barbershops in Beckenham and Locksbottom.
Find your nearest Paul's below. Both salons are open six days a week. Gents can pop into either salon; for ladies' appointments, give Downham Way a ring.

An independent, family-run group of two Bromley salons: walk-in barbers at 19A East Street and a ladies and gents salon at 420 Downham Way. Independent since the first one opened in 1978.
It started with one salon in Bromley in 1978. 48 years later Paul's is still independent and still family run, with two salons of its own and two sister businesses nearby.
Whether it's a quick clipper cut at the barbers or a full colour at the salon, the idea is the same: the look you want, done properly, by people who've been doing it in Bromley for a long time.
Paul's has two sister businesses nearby, run as their own companies.
Pop in or give us a call. We'd love to meet you.
Whether you're an experienced stylist or just starting out, if you've got the enthusiasm and the passion, we'd like to hear from you.
We work closely with a number of well-renowned colleges, so the training happens both in the salon and in the classroom.
Full apprenticeships that take you to NVQ Level 2, with training in the salon and in the classroom through the colleges we work with.
Already qualified and after a new challenge? We are always looking for good people at every level.
Specialist day courses in styling and colouring, so the learning does not stop once you qualify.
Send us your CV with a covering letter telling us about your experience and why you want to work at Paul's. Or give us a call.
